key.name: enable-codex
key.description: Query usage through the official Codex CLI's existing sign-in only after opting in. Disabling monitoring does not log out.

key.name: enable-claude
key.description: Query usage through the official Claude CLI's existing sign-in only after opting in. Sends initialize/get_usage control requests only, never a model prompt. Disabling monitoring does not log out.

key.name: codex-path
key.description: Leave empty for PATH or the native ~/.local/bin/codex location. Absolute paths only, no arguments.

key.name: claude-path
key.description: Leave empty for PATH or the native ~/.local/bin/claude location. Absolute paths only, no arguments.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: Codex and Claude CLI reads share this interval. The menu offers 15, 60 or 300 seconds; other stored values snap to the next offered choice, at most 300.
